message.content: my brother-in-law Dave is a plumber and he asked me AGAIN to help with his quotes. he records a voice memo walking the job then spends his whole sunday typing quotes. can we hack something that turns the memo into a quote pdf?

content.text: Yes. A simple pipeline: transcribe the memo, extract line items into JSON, render a PDF template.

message.content: ok the whisper transcript is decent. now pull out line items: parts, hours, call-out fee. he charges 95/hr and a 60 call-out

content.text: Here's the extraction prompt and a schema for parts, labor hours and fees.

message.content: this is actually working. he just sent 3 quotes from the van in 10 min instead of his sunday
